title: Home-Site Lease Agreement: Signing, Contracted Rent, Term Dates and Security Deposit
content:
**Article — commencement of the Home-Site Lease**

1. Only an approved application may be signed into a Home-Site Lease, and signing is the resident's own act. On signing the home is placed or occupied on the site and the lease becomes active; rent begins on the move-in date.
2. The contracted monthly site rent at signing is:
   - for a twelve-month term, the lot class's base monthly site rent;
   - for a month-to-month term, that base rent plus the lot class's month-to-month premium;
   - for a twenty-four-month term, that base rent less the lot class's twenty-four-month reduction.
3. A fixed term starts on the move-in date and ends on the day before the same calendar date twelve or twenty-four months later; a month-to-month term has no end date.
4. The security deposit equals the lot class's deposit multiple (months of rent) multiplied by the contracted monthly site rent, rounded half up to the cent, and is collected on the move-in date.
5. Autopay may be set up at signing, and the autopay discount then follows the autopay terms of the Home-Site Lease.

**Clause 2 in table form**

| Term signed | Contracted monthly site rent |
|---|---|
| twelve months | base monthly site rent |
| month to month | base monthly site rent plus month-to-month premium |
| twenty-four months | base monthly site rent less twenty-four-month reduction |

**Worked illustration (hypothetical lot class figures: base rent 700.00, month-to-month premium 45.00, twenty-four-month reduction 14.00, deposit multiple 1.5)**

| Term | Contracted rent | Deposit |
|---|---|---|
| twelve months | 700.00 | 1,050.00 |
| month to month | 745.00 | 1,117.50 |
| twenty-four months | 686.00 | 1,029.00 |

**Term dates (hypothetical move-in on 15 March 2026)**

- Twelve-month term: 15 March 2026 through 14 March 2027.
- Twenty-four-month term: 15 March 2026 through 14 March 2028.
- Month-to-month term: begins 15 March 2026 with no end date.
